changes.comment: Pure snapshot-only task context: TaskContextRenderer renders validated task summaries, updates and unresolved references into bounded, framed, escaped text with deterministic priority selection, depth/item/character budgets and an honest omission report, and returns a canonical pure inclusion receipt naming only the revisions and fully delivered update IDs it rendered. Adds ITaskSummary, ITaskUpdate, IUnresolvedTaskReference, the context value types, a host projection seam that re-validates its output, and summary/update/input/budget/receipt converters.
